notes:
Inbound: SMB wellness app focusing on guided triage + post-visit summaries. Self-serve signup; experimenting on hosted API.

Key customer context:
- "Lifeline" is a consumer-facing symptom triage and care navigation app (no direct billing, partners with clinics).
- HIPAA-adjacent: will occasionally capture PHI-like strings in free-text triage inputs; wants to avoid storing PHI when possible. Quote from lead: "We're not a covered entity but we need safeguards — can we get BAA-like controls?"

Technical/req highlights (shorthand):
- Workloads: short-turn chat for triage (prompt+context ~ 300-800 tokens), embeddings for doc search (clinical content + FAQs).
- Latency SLO: p50 120-200ms, p95 < 500ms for chat; throughput initially ~15-40 reqs/s bursty.
- Cost sensitivity: small margins, expect pilot ~50k-100k tokens/mo; want unit cost guidance and batching/caching tips.
- Model prefs: prefer open/quantized model variants if quality is comparable; want route to cheaper model for non-sensitive queries.
- Routing/fallback: fallback to smaller model during high load; need predictable degraded quality behavior.

Security/compliance asks:
- BAA conversation — they want contractual language for PHI-adjacent handling (not full HIPAA customer but need assurance).
- Retention: default logs retention? Need API to purge user transcripts and embeddings on demand. Suggested 30-day rolling retention but must be configurable per-tenant.
- Audit logs + SSO: require audit logging and SAML SSO for admin console. KMS integration for keys desirable.

Stated next steps from call:
- Customer will try hosted API free credits on PoC prompts this week (Jordan to provide example prompt templates).
- Security team follow-up scheduled: short call to review retention/BAA language (aim: week of 2026-03-15).
- Maya to prepare cost projection for 50k and 100k tokens/month including batching suggestions.

Sales notes (shorthand):
- Good PLG fit — self-serve onboarding already started. Low-touch sales unless security/legal escalates.
- Upside: if pilot goes well, potential move to Dedicated in 12-18 months for partners integration.

Stated quotes / snippets: "Can you guarantee deletion of user transcripts within 24hrs on request?" / "We need an easy toggle to disable embeddings storage for certain flows."

Links: pricing deck (drive://redwood-pricing-deck-lifeline-sprout), security Qs (drive://lifeline-security-questions-2026), support ticket INF-2042 (notes from infra team).
notes_summary: Early-stage SMB wellness lead. Using hosted API trial. HIPAA-adjacent concerns: BAA, retention, deletion API, audit logs. Wants cost projection and short security call.
